Priya Patel: Weekly check-in for HelioCorp — quick heads up, model mix shifted sharply during the rollout window. model-infer-v2 is now 47% of calls (was 15% last week). Fallbacks to model-infer-v1 spiked to 8.2% during peak.
Mateo Rivera: yikes, is that correlated to traffic or config change? :eyes:
Priya Patel: looks like both. Traffic up 22% after a campaign and we pushed canary flags at 10:20 UTC.
Samir Gupta: digging into traces — p95 latency for v2 went from 240ms -> 610ms across 80–300 token requests. Errors are mostly INVALID_KV_CACHE and OOM-ish fallback triggers.
Liz Chen: can you paste the query you used for fallback rate so I can run against prod mirror?
Samir Gupta: sure — quick query:
```sql
SELECT time_bucket('5m', ts) as t, count(*) FILTER (WHERE fallback = true)::float / count(*) as fallback_rate
FROM requests
WHERE customer_id = 'helio' AND ts > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY t
ORDER BY t
```
Priya Patel: spend for Helio is +32% WoW after the shift — should flag renewal risk if this persists. I'm recommending 2 actions: 1) temporary throttle rollout to 20% of traffic and 2) enable prefix KV caching for v2 on Dedicated pool.
Mateo Rivera: agree. I'll ask sales/finance to hold a sync with the customer and explain potential cost drift. Can we propose an enablement session to walk through caching/quantization options?
Liz Chen: I can run a 30m enablement next Tue. Samir, can you open an internal ticket for runtime team to investigate OOM/fallback threshold tuning?
Samir Gupta: opening ticket now — INC-2026: investigate v2 OOMs & fallback logic, cc @eng-runtime. ETA 48–72h.
metrics-bot: [automated] Canary deployment detected for model_infer_v2 at 2026-03-18T10:19:43Z, rollout_percent=30 -> 60 -> 30
Priya Patel: ok team — plan: roll back to 20% canary tonight at 22:00 UTC, enable caching, run enablement Tue. I'll update the Helio healthboard + tag renewal as 'watch'. Anything else?
Mateo Rivera: pls include cost forecast for next 30/60 days in healthboard. :+1:
Liz Chen: added enablement invite.
Samir Gupta: ticket created: INC-2026 link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INC-2026
Priya Patel: thanks — will follow up in next weekly check. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
